_comment: Venues for the withdrawal-ability recorder (scripts/record-venue-liquidity.mjs). These are EXTERNAL mainnet venues (Ethereum), read via RECORDER_RPC_URL — NOT the local anvil. Entry shape: {name, kind, address, underlying?, decimals, enabled, newsQuery?, notes, depthMarkets?, depthCoveredByInstant?}. Only enabled=true venues are recorded. Never guess an address; leave it empty and enabled=false until verified. newsQuery (optional) is the Google News RSS search string for scripts/fetch-venue-news.mjs — a plain-English venue name, NOT a ticker, so headlines are about the protocol, not a random symbol collision.
_comment_depth: depthMarkets (optional) = the DEPTH-VS-BOOK extension (memo P4, docs/research/worst-carry-venues.md §3). Two-sided-pool entry {name, kind:'curve-stableswap'|'uniswap-v3', address, token0, token1, exitFrom, enabled, note}: token0/token1 are coins(0)/coins(1) (curve) or token0()/token1() (univ3); exitFrom = the token a holder is exiting (venue token, or its UNDERLYING when the venue token has no deep pool); EXITABLE depth = the OTHER side (tokens you swap INTO). psm-buffer entry {name, kind:'psm-buffer', address (the PSM, provenance), buffer (address holding the gem), bufferToken (the swap-INTO token, e.g. USDC), exitFrom, enabled, note}: a peg-stability module (Sky LitePSM) redeems 1:1 against a single-sided buffer, EXITABLE depth = bufferToken.balanceOf(buffer), no skew. When a venue has MULTIPLE enabled markets, depth_usd SUMS their exitable USD and depth_skew_pct = the WORST (max) pool one-sidedness. EVERY address is on-chain-verified (coins/token/gem/pocket reads) before enabled=true — a candidate that fails verification stays enabled=false with a note, never guessed. depthCoveredByInstant=true (aave) means the venue's instant_usd read already IS its depth. A venue with neither an enabled depthMarket nor depthCoveredByInstant keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list. termsUrl (optional) = the EXACT official redemption/terms page the terms-hash watcher (scripts/watch-venue-terms.mjs) tracks; its presence drops 'terms_page_changes' from the uncovered list.

venues.name: sUSDe
venues.notes: Ethena Staked USDe (mainnet). underlying = USDe. Reads: cooldownDuration() uint24, totalAssets(), totalSupply(), silo() if present. cooling/stranded split is venue-specific and NOT fabricated here — raw params stored, instant_usd left null with a note.

depthMarkets.name: DOLA/sUSDe (Curve stableswap-ng)
depthMarkets.note: VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06: coins(0)=DOLA (symbol DOLA, 18dec), coins(1)=sUSDe (symbol sUSDe, 18dec); balances ~$40.8M DOLA / ~$12.4M sUSDe (~$53M TVL). NO deep sUSDe/USDe or sUSDe/USDC Curve or Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry scan: best sUSDe/USDC is ~$718 dust). This DOLA/sUSDe pool is sUSDe's DEEPEST secondary (instant-exit) market. exitFrom=sUSDe ⇒ exitable depth = the DOLA side (swap sUSDe INTO DOLA), valued $1/stable as a stated assumption (DOLA is Inverse Finance's stablecoin).

venues.name: aave-v3-usde
venues.notes: aEthUSDe, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: Aave V3 Pool (0x87870Bca…4fA4E2).getReserveData(USDe) returned this address; it answers symbol()='aEthUSDe' and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. instant liquidity = USDe.balanceOf(aToken) at $1/stable (assumption recorded in params). depthCoveredByInstant=true: for an aToken the instant_usd read (underlying held by the aToken) IS the exitable depth, so no secondary pool is needed and 'depth_vs_book' is NOT on this venue's uncovered list. variableDebtToken = 0x015396E1…465145, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06 from Pool.getReserveData(USDe) word 10: symbol()='variableDebtEthUSDe' (contains 'variableDebt') and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. utilization_pct = variableDebt.totalSupply()/(that + underlyingBalance)*100 (debt $285.8M, avail $360.9M => 44.2% at verification) — the utilization alarm (watch >90/alarm >95) reads it.

depthMarkets.name: USDS→USDC via Sky LitePSM (MCD_LITE_PSM_USDC_A)
depthMarkets.note: VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06 against Sky/MakerDAO chainlog (chainlog.makerdao.com/api/mainnet/active.json): MCD_LITE_PSM_USDC_A = 0xf6e72Db5…853042 with gem()=USDC (0xA0b8…eB48, 6dec), dai()=DAI (0x6B17…71d0F), pocket()=0x37305B1c…D7341 == chainlog MCD_LITE_PSM_USDC_A_POCKET. sUSDS's real INSTANT exit is USDS→USDC 1:1 via this LitePSM (Uniswap v4 pools and Curve are either singleton-unaddressable or dust — see the disabled entry below). exitFrom=USDS ⇒ exitable depth = USDC.balanceOf(pocket) (the PSM holds $0 itself; the pocket holds the buffer, ~$3.99B at verification), valued $1/stable. Single-sided buffer ⇒ no skew; a drain shows in depth_collapse, not depth_skew.

depthMarkets.name: USDS/USDC (none deep enough — UNVERIFIED, not enabled)
depthMarkets.note: NO verifiable deep USDS/USDC (or sUSDS) Curve/Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry + DeFiLlama scan 2026-09-06: best USDS/USDC Curve pool ~$4k dust). Deep USDS DEX liquidity lives in Uniswap v4 (PYUSD-USDS ~$100M, USDT-USDS ~$50M) — a singleton PoolManager the reader cannot address by pool contract — and Sky's PSM (a peg-stability module, not an AMM). Left enabled:false: never guess an address. Consequence: sUSDS keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list until a v4-capable reader or a verified curve/univ3 pool is added.
